# Specification Quality Checklist: Postgres Query Dungeon

**Purpose**: Validate whether the specification is clear, complete, measurable, and scoped for an MVP implementation of the PostgreSQL optimization training lab.
**Created**: 2026-05-17
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are the project's learning goals explicitly tied to PostgreSQL query optimization skills rather than generic backend training? [Completeness, Spec §User Scenarios & Testing]
- [x] CHK002 Are all required puzzle artifacts documented for every SQL puzzle: business story, bad SQL, runner command, expected result, baseline plan, hints, solution notes, and solution migration? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006]
- [x] CHK003 Are requirements defined for the full learner loop: setup, seed, run, explain, benchmark, apply solution, compare, and reset? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, Spec §SC-007]
- [x] CHK004 Are the 12 minimum puzzles constrained by required plan symptoms, index families, rewrite categories, difficulty levels, and anti-pattern tags? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005, Spec §FR-007-FR-021]
- [x] CHK005 Are dataset requirements complete enough to support users, orders, products, payments, events, reviews, and inventory relationships? [Completeness, Spec §FR-018, Spec §Key Entities]
- [x] CHK006 Are requirements defined for both intentionally bad query variants and optimized reference variants for each puzzle? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011, Spec §FR-012]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK007 Is the term "intentionally bad" clarified so bad queries remain business-meaningful and not arbitrary waste work? [Clarity, Spec §FR-022, Spec §Training Scenario Contract]
- [x] CHK008 Is "large synthetic dataset" quantified with a bounded default size suitable for local laptops? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003, Spec §SC-003]
- [x] CHK009 Is the primary interface unambiguous as CLI-first, with REST API explicitly optional? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004, Spec §FR-017]
- [x] CHK010 Is the PostgreSQL 16+ version decision clear enough for planning Docker image selection and version-specific lesson notes? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001, Spec §FR-023]
- [x] CHK011 Are difficulty levels limited to a canonical set with no room for alternate labels? [Clarity, Spec §FR-019, Spec §Key Entities]
- [x] CHK012 Are anti-pattern tags defined as a closed canonical list rather than open-ended labels? [Clarity, Spec §FR-020, Spec §Key Entities]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK013 Are baseline requirements consistently separated from reference optimization requirements across functional requirements, scenario contract, and success criteria? [Consistency, Spec §FR-010-FR-012]
- [x] CHK014 Do CLI-first requirements align with the assumption that REST API support is optional and non-blocking? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004, Spec §FR-017, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK015 Are PostgreSQL 16+ support statements consistent rather than competing version targets? [Consistency, Spec §Clarifications, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK016 Are benchmark requirements consistent with the warning that absolute timings vary by machine? [Consistency, Spec §FR-013, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK017 Are "not production ready" requirements consistent with the intentionally inefficient design and local-only training scope? [Consistency, Spec §FR-015, Spec §Assumptions]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK018 Are success criteria measurable for every critical learner outcome: local start, puzzle completeness, dataset generation, correctness equivalence, benchmark evidence, and reset replay? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-001-SC-011]
- [x] CHK019 Can every SQL puzzle's acceptance criteria be objectively evaluated from written requirements without inventing extra puzzle metadata? [Measurability, Spec §FR-006, Spec §Training Scenario Contract]
- [x] CHK020 Are EXPLAIN-related acceptance criteria specific enough to require `EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS)` evidence for every puzzle? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §FR-010, Spec §SC-011]
- [x] CHK021 Are before/after measurement requirements specific about latency, rows, buffers, planning time, and execution time? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §FR-013, Spec §SC-005]
- [x] CHK022 Is the "within 15 minutes" onboarding target scoped to documented quest instructions and local setup expectations? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-001]

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK023 Are primary learning scenarios covered for starting the lab, completing puzzles, measuring improvements, and replaying the quest? [Coverage, Spec §User Scenarios & Testing]
- [x] CHK024 Are each-puzzle requirements sufficient to support independent puzzle execution and comparison? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 2, Spec §User Story 3]
- [x] CHK025 Are requirements defined for learners encountering an already optimized state before baseline capture? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK026 Are requirements defined for deterministic result comparison when query outputs include ties, date boundaries, or nullable values? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK027 Are requirements defined for baseline regeneration after reset and seed workflow? [Coverage, Spec §SC-011]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK028 Are requirements specified for interrupted or repeated seed generation so data reproducibility remains defined? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK029 Are requirements specified for running a puzzle before the dataset is available? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK030 Are local machine variability and relative comparison expectations explicitly addressed? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK031 Does the spec define safeguards against too-heavy local execution beyond the 1-5 million row default? [Gap, Spec §FR-003, Spec §SC-003]
- [x] CHK032 Are requirements defined for optional smaller or faster seed profiles for constrained machines? [Gap, Spec §FR-003]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [x] CHK033 Are reproducibility requirements clear for Docker-based PostgreSQL startup, deterministic seeding, baseline plan capture, and benchmarks? [Non-Functional, Spec §FR-001-FR-003, Spec §FR-010]
- [x] CHK034 Are performance measurement requirements framed as training evidence rather than production service performance targets? [Non-Functional, Spec §FR-013, Spec §FR-015]
- [x] CHK035 Are local resource constraints sufficiently specified to prevent the MVP from requiring workstation-class hardware? [Non-Functional, Spec §SC-003, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK036 Are observability expectations for benchmark and plan outputs documented enough for learners to compare rows, buffers, planning time, and execution time? [Non-Functional, Spec §FR-013]

## MVP Scope & Boundaries

- [x] CHK037 Is MVP scope bounded to local single-learner training, with hosted leaderboards, authentication, and multi-user tracking excluded? [Scope, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK038 Is the REST API clearly optional so MVP implementation can succeed with CLI-only workflows? [Scope, Spec §FR-017, Spec §SC-010]
- [x] CHK039 Are production-readiness expectations explicitly excluded to prevent hardening work from displacing training scenario delivery? [Scope, Spec §FR-015]
- [x] CHK040 Is the puzzle catalog scope narrow enough for MVP delivery while still covering all required plan symptoms, index types, rewrite categories, and anti-pattern tags? [Scope, Spec §FR-007-FR-021]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK041 Are assumptions about learner skill level, local command-line usage, and SQL familiarity documented? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK042 Are assumptions about synthetic data and absence of real user data documented clearly enough to avoid privacy or compliance work? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK043 Is the TypeScript + Node.js stack decision documented with rationale and aligned with CLI, data generation, benchmark, and test requirements? [Assumption, Spec §Clarifications, Spec §FR-016]
- [x] CHK044 Are version-specific PostgreSQL behavior dependencies required to be documented at puzzle level? [Dependency, Spec §FR-023]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [x] CHK045 Is there any unresolved ambiguity about whether each puzzle needs one or multiple reference optimizations? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-006, Spec §Training Scenario Contract]
- [x] CHK046 Is there any conflict between requiring reference migrations and allowing non-index SQL rewrite optimizations? [Potential Conflict, Spec §FR-006, Spec §FR-009]
- [x] CHK047 Is "baseline EXPLAIN output" defined as stored artifact, regenerated artifact, or both in a way that planning can implement consistently? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-010, Spec §Training Scenario Contract]
- [x] CHK048 Is the acceptance model for "every required plan symptom appears at least once" traceable to puzzle metadata requirements? [Traceability, Spec §FR-007, Spec §SC-006]
